readOnlyCommandsForNextAuthorizedStaging.boundedPositioningRowsQuery: ssh staging 'docker compose -f /opt/iqterminal/compose.yaml exec -T clickhouse clickhouse-client --query "SELECT toUnixTimestamp64Milli(now64(3)) AS queriedAtMs,venue,market,nativeSymbol,sourceTimeMs,observedAtMs,epoch,toString(value) AS valueDecimal,units,source,sourceTimeQuality,quality,gapBefore FROM iqterminal.positioning_oi FINAL WHERE sourceTimeMs >= toUInt64(toUnixTimestamp64Milli(now64(3))-14400000) AND sourceTimeMs < toUnixTimestamp64Milli(now64(3)) ORDER BY sourceTimeMs DESC,venue LIMIT 2001 FORMAT JSONEachRow"'
acceptanceConditions: Require the remote deployment to identify server PR head 6bb5dc20074c62622edd5499fb57f3cdeb8c4202 or a specifically reviewed later commit before accepting route results; do not accept main 26337e4e618fce1c2ad1da0f38754837a7f55a4d or the old 20261027-r1 image as PR evidence.

Verify the response preserves the requested from/to and exact venue set. Compare returned sourceTimeMs, observedAtMs, epoch, decimal value, units, source, timestamp quality, quality and gapBefore against the bounded FINAL query.
For the default venue set, require explicit unavailable/unverified Bybit metadata and zero fabricated Bybit observations; absence of a response or a dropped venue is not acceptance.

Check stale flags against the 75000 ms threshold and empty-history state only from actual staging observations; do not age or inject fixture records. If no genuine stale or empty state occurs, record it as unobserved.

In a fresh no-fixture staging browser, attach Open Interest to both charts, exercise venue selection, verify the shared poller, and confirm the existing Net Longs/Net Shorts recorder path still works.
Run the explicit default venue request and a second request with the venues parameter omitted; require the latter to preserve the default venue set rather than silently drop Bybit.
Use the one-hour Bybit-only request as a bounded genuine empty-history case. Require zero observations plus explicit unavailable/unverified Bybit metadata.

For stale state, compare each response feed lastObservedAt age with the 75000 ms threshold and the returned stale flag. Do not alter timestamps or insert fixtures; if no natural stale source occurs, record it as unobserved.
